#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ENV_NAME="${1:-}"
DIR="{{env_dir}}"

if [[ -z "$ENV_NAME" ]]; then
  echo "usage: $0 <dev|staging|prod>"; exit 1
fi

SRC="$DIR/.env.$ENV_NAME"
[[ -f "$SRC" ]] || { echo "no $SRC"; exit 1; }

ln -sf "$SRC" "$DIR/.env"
echo "switched to $ENV_NAME ($(readlink $DIR/.env))"
